scope: offline and staked C ABI 4 simulation, event, objective and presentation parity; not network, renderer or execution-proof qualification

input_encoding.order: tick-major then permanent slot ascending; no padding, tick and slot implicit

source_identity.normalization: replace CRLF with LF in UTF-8 source bytes
source_identity.scope: exact files owning the exercised World/geometry/combat/economy/C ABI plus dependency manifests; unrelated transport/proof implementation is excluded

digest_encoding: SHA-256 domain prefixes in verify_parity.py; named C fields encoded individually in declared order as little-endian scalars, excluding padding; event streams include every tick, its count and every event; state streams include every completed tick and native state hash; presentation streams include the snapshot, every player and presentation, projectile, entity and the objective snapshot
